name: ma-financial-statements
description: Use this skill whenever asked about financial statements, statutory accounts, or financial reporting obligations for self-employed people and small businesses in Morocco for tax year 2026: who has to prepare formal accounts and who does not, the etats de synthese (Bilan, CPC, ESG, Tableau de financement, ETIC), how accounts go to the DGI with the return, deposit at the court registry (depot legal), and when a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is required. Trigger on phrases like "Morocco financial statements", "états de synthèse", "bilan CPC Maroc", "do I file accounts Morocco", "comptes annuels Maroc", "CGNC états de synthèse", "tableau de financement", "ETIC", "commissaire aux comptes Maroc", "dépôt des comptes Maroc", "القوائم المالية المغرب", "الميزانية المغرب". Auto-entrepreneur and CPU taxpayers fall outside CGI Art. 145; RNS keeps the Art. 145-VI registers; RNR taxpayers and companies keep accounts under Art. 145-I. Reply in the user's language (English, French, or Mor
